sources.title: Codex Chrome extension - OpenAI Developers
relevance: Confirms Chrome is for signed-in browser state while in-app Browser is preferred for pages that do not need Chrome profile state.
Confirms setup requires the Chrome plugin, Codex Chrome Extension install, permission prompts, and Connected status.
Confirms troubleshooting steps: ensure Chrome profile with extension installed/enabled, Chrome plugin on, restart/new thread if needed, and re-add plugin if native host or connection remains broken.
